To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
fatty acids bound to the Fasciola hepatica FA-binding protein differ from fatty acids found in the whole fluke extract.
the FA composition of the purified nFh12 is different from the FA composition of adult F. hepatica extracts.
the nFh-12 protein, which is a candidate vaccine, differs in its FA content compared to the FA in the whole fluke.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the FA composition of nFh12 purified native FA-binding proteins, a potential vaccine for fascioliasis.
the identification of FA bound to nFh12, a candidate vaccine.
identifying the FA that are bound to a vaccine candidate and the differences that exist between the FA composition of the vaccine candidate vs. the whole adult worm extract.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the nFhFA-BP protein complex contains more n−6 than n−3 PUFA than does the total FA extract of the adult fluke.
the FAs and other lipids in the nF12 protein complex are different from those found in the whole adult fluke extract.
the FA composition of nFh12 is not similar to the FA in the whole extract of F. hepatica.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nFh 12 protein complex is a unique FA-binding protein with a distinct FA composition.

the nFh 12 protein complex binds a variety of different FA, but these differ from the FA that are present in the whole adult fluke extract, and the binding of cholesterol and sterols is a novel observation for a FA-binding protein.
the nFh 12 protein complex has a unique FA composition that may contribute to its immunogenicity and protective efficacy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the FA bound to the nFH12 protein are significantly different from those in whole fluke extracts.
the FAs bound to the n−12 kDa protein differ from those in whole extracts of adult F. hepatica.
the FA composition of the nFh 12 protein differs significantly from the FA composition of whole extracts of F. hepatica.
